episode.final_message:
## Readout

The dashboard’s apparent online drop is a **partial-month comparison**. Executive daily detail shows September 1–19 net sales of 1,371,704.27, including 484,648.16 Online, against all 31 days of August at 2,292,267.50 total and 843,730.63 Online. Those raw differences are −40.2% overall and −42.6% Online; they do not establish a comparable monthly decline. [superset|chart:10]

In the latest two fully covered months, July to August, total net sales **rose 133,272.76 (+6.2%)**. Online rose 61,949.94 (+7.9%), accounting for 46.5% of the total increase. These are channel contributions to the arithmetic change, not causes. The owner’s declared coverage rule treats earlier months as complete and a final month as complete only when the latest date reaches month end. [superset|chart:10; northstar-steward://sales/coverage]

The saved chart reads `order_date`, `channel`, `region`, and `net_sales` from `gold.mart_executive_daily`, with no filters. It returned 8,937 rows through September 19; it was captured October 16 and has a 10,000-row limit. The source declares no freshness SLA, so the gap between capture and latest date is unexplained. [superset|chart:10] The owner defines this `net_sales` as the official management figure, not GAAP revenue, settled cash, marketing-attributed revenue, or a unique-customer metric. [northstar-owner://sales/meaning]

## Saved draft

Card **card-executive-net-sales-coverage-channel-check-3a4b11bc**, version 2, is a draft with `superset|chart:10` as its sole required source and the prior calendar month as its comparison window.

Its proposed policy sends partial or unknown coverage to Data Trust; for a valid full-month comparison, a decline of at least 15% goes to Leadership, otherwise an absolute change of at least 10% goes to Analytics, and smaller changes are ignored without a triggered recipient. [northstar-owner://sales/check; northstar-owner://sales/policy]

The onboarding source check found that the chart lacks an adapter-owned metric, population, grain, and comparison-window contract needed for automatic routing. I corrected the draft’s comparison window to match the owner’s declared policy. The separate review endpoint ranks catalog candidates with Jev, so I did not call it under your restriction; formal review of version 2 remains outstanding.

I saved the reusable brief in my notes. The card remains unapproved; no evaluation, schedule, or message send occurred.

## Unresolved

- What freshness or ingestion cadence should be expected when the chart was captured October 16 but its latest `order_date` is September 19?
- Can the data steward provide the source-owned metric, population, grain, and monthly comparison contract needed to review automatic routing?
- The source does not declare a currency, so the figures are reported as `net_sales` numbers.

saved_card.title: Executive Net Sales Coverage & Channel Check
saved_card.what_to_watch: Track the latest reported Executive daily-detail net_sales month, its coverage status, the prior fully covered calendar month, and each source-reported channel's contribution to the total change. Highlight Online as an optional channel breakdown.
saved_card.why_watch: The owner wants a reusable check to determine whether an apparent online-sales hit is a real movement in the official Executive management sales figure and how channels account for the total movement.
watch_for: Coverage of the latest reported calendar month from the Executive daily-detail model's latest order_date
Comparable full-month movement in official net_sales
Online and other channel contributions to the total net_sales change

sources.label: Executive daily detail — official reported net_sales by order_date, channel, and region

saved_card.decision_guidance: Use only the Executive daily-detail model's source-reported net_sales and channel categories. This is the official management sales figure, not GAAP revenue, settled cash, marketing-attributed revenue, or a unique-customer metric. Determine the latest observed order_date from this same model. Per the owner's declared policy, daily reporting is complete through that date and earlier calendar months are complete; the final observed calendar month is complete only if that date reaches its last calendar day. Do not compare a partial latest month with a full prior month as a business decline. If the latest month is partial or coverage cannot be established, return insufficient_data to Data Trust for that comparison, and still report the two most recent fully covered months when supported. For an established complete comparable monthly comparison, a net_sales decline of at least 15% means notify Leadership. Otherwise, an absolute net_sales change of at least 10% means investigate with Analytics. Smaller absolute changes mean ignore with no triggered recipient. Show Online and other channel contributions as an accounting decomposition of total change. Channel, digital-funnel, or marketing detail is explanatory follow-up only; do not combine marketing-attributed revenue or digital-commerce revenue with Executive net_sales and do not claim causality from correlation.
saved_card.follow_up_guidance: When the latest month is partial or its coverage is unknown, state the measured coverage gap, route the comparison to Data Trust, and give the latest two fully covered months if available. For a valid movement, show total net_sales change and channel accounting contributions; suggest deeper funnel or marketing investigation only as a question when evidence supports it.

delivery_methods.label: Notify Leadership
delivery_methods.instructions: Only for a complete comparable monthly net_sales decline of at least 15%.

delivery_methods.label: Investigate with Analytics
delivery_methods.instructions: For an absolute monthly net_sales change of at least 10% that is not a decline of at least 15%.

delivery_methods.label: Check coverage with Data Trust
delivery_methods.instructions: When the latest month is partial or its coverage cannot be established.
